additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395708-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004167] No stop meter value after power loss CRM:00643001166
additional_info.body:
Hi Benjamin,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs, and it was quite difficult to retrieve them, as the charger was rebooted during the ongoing charging session due to a power failure from the grid or because of an unstable 24VDC power supply to the PLC. If the 24VDC supply fluctuates for an extended period, the charger will reboot. When we analyzed the logs in both SCB and AWS, we found that there are no logs between 13:36 and 14:05 UTC for approximately half an hour. When the charger rebooted, it shows the stop transaction as zero, as the charger also lacks a DC LEM meter to register the previous values.
I hope this explanation is clear. If there are no further queries, may we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
